units.source_text: 朱雀院五十寿辰，首先是皇上庆祝，规模盛大之极。

en.t: For Suzaku-in's fiftieth birthday, the Emperor was the first to hold a celebration, and it was magnificently grand in scale.

units.source_text: 源氏不便和皇上并比，把日子稍稍延迟，定在二月中旬。

en.t: Genji felt it would be improper to seem to rival the Emperor, so he set his own date a little later, in the middle of the second month.

units.source_text: 乐人和舞人便天天前来演习，络绎不绝。

en.t: Musicians and dancers came every day to rehearse, arriving in an unbroken stream.

units.source_text: 源氏对三公主说：“紫夫人常想听你弹琴。

en.t: Genji said to the Third Princess, "Lady Murasaki has long wished to hear you play the koto.

units.source_text: 我想定个日子，叫你和这里弹筝弹琵琶的女眷合奏，开一个女乐大会。

en.t: I would like to choose a day for you to join the ladies here who play the so and the biwa, and hold a women's concert together.

units.source_text: 我看当代音乐名手，修养都不及六条院诸女眷的精深呢。

en.t: It seems to me that even the famous musicians of our time do not have the depth of cultivation found among the ladies of Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 我在音乐上算不得专家，但自幼关心此道，总希望在任何方面没有不懂得的事。

en.t: I cannot call myself an expert in music, but I have cared about it since childhood and have always wanted there to be no part of it I did not understand.

units.source_text: 因此世间所有音乐名师，以及高贵之家承继名手祖传的人，我全都请教过。

en.t: For that reason, I have sought instruction from all the renowned music masters in the world, as well as from those in noble houses who inherited the traditions of great performers.

units.source_text: 然而其中真个精深博雅使我叹佩的人，实在不曾见过。

en.t: Yet among them, I have truly never met anyone whose depth and broad refinement made me sigh in admiration.

units.source_text: 而现今的青年，大都油腔滑调，比我们一代的人浅薄得多。

en.t: As for the young people nowadays, most are smooth and glib, and far more superficial than those of our generation.

units.source_text: 况且七弦琴这乐器，听说现今已无人学习。

en.t: Moreover, as for the seven-stringed kin, I hear that no one studies that instrument anymore.

units.source_text: 学到像你那样程度的人，实在很难得了。”

en.t: Someone who has learned it to the level you have reached is truly rare."

units.source_text: 三公主天真烂漫地微笑，她听见源氏如此赞扬她，心中不胜欢喜。

en.t: The Third Princess smiled with innocent delight, and when she heard Genji praise her in this way, her heart was filled with joy.

units.source_text: 她今年已经二十一二岁了，然而还同未成年一样，一派稚气。

en.t: She was already twenty-one or twenty-two that year, yet she still seemed like a minor, with an entirely childish air.

units.source_text: 身材瘦小，但容貌十分秀美。

en.t: Her figure was slight and small, but her face was exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏随时随地教导她：“你多年不见父亲了。

en.t: Genji instructed her whenever the occasion arose: "You have not seen your father for many years.

units.source_text: 此次前往参见，须要小心在意，让他看见你长大成人，心中欢喜。”

en.t: When you go to visit him this time, you must take great care, so that he may see you grown into adulthood and be happy at heart."

units.source_text: 众侍女相与告道：“对啊！若非大人如此悉心管教，她那孩子脾气就更加不能隐藏了呢。”

en.t: The waiting women said to one another, "Exactly! If His Lordship had not guided her so carefully, her childish temperament would be even harder to conceal."
